scenarios.prompt: A 2D skeletal character needs locomotion, attack overlay and face tracks, with hitstop affecting only the struck actor. Define the skeletal presentation contract.

criteria.ownership: Skeleton hierarchy, weighting, tracks and playback are owned here; combat timing remains with gameplay skills.
criteria.fallback: Mesh density/data format are selected from deformation/runtime needs, not fixed universal numbers.
criteria.evidence: Acceptance checks bind deformation, overlay tracks and per-actor hitstop in the actual runtime or a recorded equivalent.
